{{Quote|Smooth, creamy and colder than a wampa's whiskers, this is soft ice cream the way you remember it! Let our soft ice cream droid prepare you a Cerean cone with denta bean or Trammistan chocolate.|Dex's Diner menu, on its soft ice cream|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Cerean cones''' were a type of [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream]] cone. Scoops of soft ice cream, such as [[denta bean ice cream]] and [[trammistan chocolate ice cream]], were served in Cerean cones at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Menu" /> The cones shared their names with the [[Cerean/Legends|Cereans]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with large skulls.<ref name="Force and Destiny Core">''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Cerean cones were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
